result.question: Immediately after Jehoiada made the covenants, what did all the people of the land do at the temple of Baal?
result.answer: They tore it down, smashed the altars and idols to pieces, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
result.reason: This limits the question to the people’s immediate response in verse 18 and includes all their stated actions, avoiding the ambiguity created by later events.
